title: Processed Foods Offer the Cheapest Calories
description: This boxplot shows that ultra-processed foods have the lowest price per calorie, using data from the Grocery Store Foods dataset. As processing increases, calories become cheaper—highlighting how affordability often comes at the cost of nutritional quality.

title: Hourly and Seasonal Trends in Marginal Cost of Energy
description: This presents a heatmap of average Marginal Cost of Energy (MCE) by hour of the day and month, using data from 2012 through 2024. This visualization highlights both systematic intra-day pricing patterns and their seasonal amplification.

title: Qini Curve for Treatment Effect Evaluation
description: This line chart displays a Qini curve, used to evaluate how well a model identifies individuals who benefit most from a treatment. The x-axis shows the proportion of the population, and the y-axis shows cumulative gain—higher curves indicate stronger model performance in treatment effect estimation.
